title: Active hours window is wide or restarts fall inside it

maxHours.text: Hours during which restarts are suppressed

report.title: {Items.Count} update {Plural(Items.Count, 'ring has', 'rings have')} an active hours window longer than {params.maxHours} hours

messages.businessImpact: With a wide active hours window there is little time left for the restart that completes an update, so updates stay pending and deadlines pass without effect.
remediation: Reduce the active hours window to a realistic working day.
messages.cannotSee: The active hours the ring sets are read, not the hours anybody keeps. A window that crosses midnight is measured forwards from its start, so 20:00 to 06:00 is ten hours. A ring that sets no active hours is not judged, since Windows then applies its own and this tool cannot see them.
